author: /root/stage05_g3_contract
frozen_runtime_policy: Do not apply until the ongoing ORDINARY_V01 is closed; preserve its source pins and raw observations.
replay_plan: After ORDINARY_V01 closes, independently pin its child_stdout.raw, launch.json, receipt.json and exact referenced checkpoint JSON bytes. Preserve originals. Use only the closed recorded observation; do not relaunch any child or native/model workload.

Independently review the exact postimage and the focused stdlib replay harness. Pin all source and raw inputs before loading. The harness may AST-extract only the closed constants and progress_line into a fresh namespace, not import or execute the owner supervisor module, main(), application, native callbacks or transports.

Parse recorded event rows using the existing child schema, launch binding, child PID, operation start and sequence. Readback witnesses must pass exact path/size/SHA256 checks against the retained copy before readback_verified=True. Extracting lines for replay never advances a real deadline or opens a new operation.

For each recorded STATUS/STAGE05_CHECKPOINT, assert one exact closed-step display line after readback verification and assert the evidence SHA256 matches the retained bytes. For every recorded PHASE_ENTER/EXIT assert entered/exited, closed phase label, known span label where applicable, explicit execution-event wording and finite cumulative clock values.

Use separately labelled replay mutations only: unverified/missing readback, unknown checkpoint name, unknown span name, HEARTBEAT, arbitrary text fields and sentinel metadata. Assert no checkpoint for unverified/unknown steps, no sentinel disclosure, no HEARTBEAT progress line and no unknown span echo. Do not rewrite retained actual event bytes.

Statically verify the helper is called after existing validation and first-failure gating, and the patch does not alter timing/deadline/heartbeat/acceptance/cleanup/child dispatch code. Preserve timing source SHA256. This is a display-only replay control, not a new ordinary/native owner witness.

Persist the replay output and exact checked input/source hashes in a new exclusive result directory, plus independent review. Report covered actual rows and any unobserved phase/checkpoint branch separately; fixture coverage cannot substitute for an actual checkpoint.
scope: One pure formatting helper with three closed literal sets.
One display hook after existing child, binding, sequence, event, readback, deadline and first-failure processing.
semantics_preserved: No new imports or I/O beyond existing show().
No child argv, stdin, process, native, model, permission or acceptance changes.
No deadline.event(), semantic credit, heartbeat, status interval, receipt, retry or cleanup changes.
Unknown step names are not displayed; unknown span names are omitted. Raw evidence bodies and arbitrary event metadata are never displayed.
Checkpoint text claims only a verified saved readback. Phase enter/exit claims only an execution event. Neither implies Stage05 acceptance.
Times are cumulative: event-observed child wall/CPU, parent-monotonic native union and remaining operation time. No per-phase speedup claim.
